def test_nullable_and_numpy_bool_share_fast_path():
    n = 30000
    df_np = pd.DataFrame({"g": [i % 5000 for i in range(n)], "v": [True, False] * (n // 2)})
    vals = ([True, False, pd.NA] * ((n // 3) + 1))[:n]
    df_na = pd.DataFrame({"g": [i % 5000 for i in range(n)], "v": pd.array(vals, dtype="boolean")})
    def get_hows(df, meth):
        gb = df.groupby("g")[["v"]]
        with patch.object(gb._grouper, "_cython_operation", wraps=gb._grouper._cython_operation) as spy:
            getattr(gb, meth)()
        hows = []
        for c in spy.call_args_list:
            args, kwargs = c
            if len(args) >= 3:
                hows.append(args[2])
            elif "how" in kwargs:
                hows.append(kwargs["how"])
        return hows
    assert get_hows(df_np, "any") == get_hows(df_na, "any"), "nullable boolean any should use same fast path as numpy bool any"

import numpy as np

def test_any_bool_categorical_unobserved():
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "g": pd.Categorical(["a", "a", "b"], categories=["a", "b", "c"]),

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def test_all_bool_categorical_unobserved():
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "g": pd.Categorical(["a", "a", "b"], categories=["a", "b", "c"]),
            "v": [True, True, False],
